summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by 20/20 Biolabs, Inc. reporting entry into a material definitive agreement (a securities purchase agreement with Streeterville Capital) that was previously disclosed. The filing details the terms of previously issued convertible notes, warrants, and series E convertible preferred stock in connection with a direct listing. There is no new special situation event; the filing is a routine update of prior private placement transactions. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is apparent.
